const CodeAbsentAtVersion
const CodeCapacity
const CodeClosed
const CodeCorrupt
const CodeIDConflict
const CodeIDExpired
const CodeIncarnationMismatch
const CodeInvalidArgument
const CodeNotFound
const CodeNotOwner
const CodeOutcomeUnknown
const CodeRouteChanged
const CodeSchemaMismatch
const CodeStateMissing
const CodeUnavailable
const CodeUnsupported
func (e *Error) Error() string
func (e *Error) Unwrap() error
func (n *Node) Close(ctx context.Context) error
func (n *Node) Collect(ctx context.Context, ref Ref) error
func (n *Node) Create(ctx context.Context, key string, req Request, fn func(*Tx) ([]byte, error)) (Ref, Result, error)
func (n *Node) Evict(ctx context.Context, ref Ref) error
func (n *Node) Export(ctx context.Context, ref Ref, w io.Writer) (Version, error)
func (n *Node) Import(ctx context.Context, key string, req Request, r io.Reader) (Ref, Result, error)
func (n *Node) Lookup(ctx context.Context, ref Ref, id MutationID) (res Result, err error)
func (n *Node) Migrate(ctx context.Context, ref Ref, req Request, to uint32, fn func(*Tx) error) (Result, error)
func (n *Node) Owner() Owner
func (n *Node) Read(ctx context.Context, ref Ref, schema uint32, fn func(*View) ([]byte, error)) (res Result, err error)
func (n *Node) Release(ctx context.Context, ref Ref) error
func (n *Node) Resolve(ctx context.Context, key string) (Route, error)
func (n *Node) Stats() Stats
func (n *Node) Takeover(ctx context.Context, observed Route) (Route, error)
func (n *Node) Update(ctx context.Context, ref Ref, req Request, fn func(*Tx) ([]byte, error)) (Result, error)
func (t *Tx) Exec(ctx context.Context, q string, args ...any) (sql.Result, error)
func (t *Tx) Query(ctx context.Context, q string, args []any, fn func(*sql.Rows) error) error
func (v *View) Query(ctx context.Context, q string, args []any, fn func(*sql.Rows) error) error
func NewMutationID(t time.Time) (MutationID, error)
func Open(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*Node, error)
func Preferred(key string, nodeIDs []string) (string, error)
type Code string
type Config struct {
	S3		*s3.Client
	Bucket		string
	Prefix		string
	NodeID		string
	CacheDir	string
	Limits		Limits
	Logger		*slog.Logger

	Extend	func(*sqlite.Driver) error
}
type Error struct {
	Code		Code
	Operation	MutationID
	Route		*Route
	At		Version
	Schema		uint32
	RetryAfter	time.Duration
	Message		string
	cause		error
}
type Limits struct {
	EntityBytes, CacheBytes				int64
	ResultBytes, ResidentEntities, InflightStorage	int
	PendingPerEntity, Recoveries, BatchMax		int
	StorageAttemptTimeout, CommitTimeout		time.Duration
	IdleTimeout, ReceiptRetention			time.Duration
}
type MutationID [24]byte
type Node struct {
	cfg	Config
	st	store.Store
	drv	*engine.Driver
	ns	head.ID
	self	head.Owner
	dir	string
	lock	*os.File
	now	func() time.Time

	mu		sync.Mutex
	entities	map[string]*entity
	reserved	int64
	recoveries	chan struct{}
	staging		atomic.Int64
	logged		atomic.Int64
	closed		bool

	done		chan struct{}
	counters	counters
	wg		sync.WaitGroup
	skipMaintenance	bool
}
type Owner struct {
	NodeID	string
	Session	[16]byte
}
type Ref struct {
	Key		string
	Incarnation	[16]byte
}
type Request struct {
	ID	MutationID
	Hash	[32]byte
	Schema	uint32
}
type Result struct {
	Value		[]byte
	Version		Version
	Replayed	bool
}
type Route struct {
	Ref		Ref
	Owner		Owner
	Epoch		uint64
	Revision	uint64
}
type Stats struct {
	Reads, Mutations, Commits, Replays, Expired, Conflicts		uint64
	ReadRejections, MutationRejections, UnknownOutcomes		uint64
	OwnerChanges, Activations, ActivationFailures, Corruptions	uint64
	CASAttempts, CASConflicts, AmbiguousPuts			uint64
	Snapshots, Compactions, Collections, CollectedObjects		uint64
	SnapshotBytes, CompactionInputBytes, CompactionOutputBytes	uint64
	CollectedBytes, UploadedBytes, DownloadedBytes			uint64
	ResidentEntities, QueuedRequests, InflightStorage		int64
	CacheBytes, StagingBytes					int64
	OldestUnresolved						time.Duration
	Batches								[maxBatch]uint64
	Storage								[4]struct {
		Attempts, Failures		uint64
		UploadedBytes, DownloadedBytes	uint64
	}
}
type Tx struct{ t *engine.Tx }
type Version struct {
	Incarnation	[16]byte
	Sequence	uint64
}
type View struct{ v *engine.View }
